result.summary: The transfer MSG01002 (ENC-T1, WARD-A to WARD-B, 08:20Z) failed with a 503 ward_unavailable error. The receiver is at version 1, admitted on WARD-A; its only history entry is the admit (MSG01001). There is no receipt (404) and no later events, so the transfer looks due and allowed (version 1 to 2). Resending would apply one movement: the WARD-A bed freed, the WARD-B bed occupied, pharmacy redirected, one porter task (effect contract for Transfer). But the route's capability profile (read 13:30:31Z, HTTP 200) shows conditional_writes=false, so the resend cannot be guarded on version 1. If the record changes before the write lands, a resend could apply the transfer twice or move the location backwards (DEP-2.2). Doing nothing leaves the patient recorded on WARD-A, so the bed board, pharmacy and EPR show the wrong ward until the transfer is applied (DEP-2.3). Reconcile is not supported because there is no receipt. Dry run and receipts are available. Catalogue entry E8 prefers escalate; an unguarded resend is an alternative only if a person approves it after checking the encounter's state by hand.

Read the dependency inventory and the effect contracts with search_effects: which systems read the downstream system's state, what a movement changes for them, and which effects are visible from here.
2. Work out the effect of each option: a resend applies one movement conditional on the receiver's version (it fails safely when the version moved); a reconciliation records a committed movement and changes nothing at the receiver; doing nothing leaves the receiver as it is. Say which effects Shutter can verify afterwards (the receipt and the history) and which it cannot (consumers downstream).
3. Decide your disposition from the impact view only:
   - resend when the effect is one bounded movement, the receiver supports conditional writes and dry runs, and the receiver's state shows it would apply;
   - reconcile when a receipt shows the movement already in effect;
   - superseded when a later applied event means a resend would move the record backwards;
   - escalate when the receiver cannot guard the write (no conditional writes) or the effect cannot be bounded;
   - more_evidence when the capability profile or the receiver's state could not be read.
4. Put what you could not know in unknowns, cite the items you used, and call SubmitFindings once."}
